links.outcome: Proportion of chatbot text exchanges with incorrect medication or symptom recommendations
links.effect: 284 of 3,895 (7.3%) medication-related and 13 of 527 (2.5%) symptom-related exchanges had incorrect recommendations; accurate in >90% of exchanges.
links.quote: We identified 284 of 3,895 (7.3%) medication-related and 13 of 527 (2.5%) symptom-related text messaging exchanges with incorrect recommendations.

unlisted_practices: Iterative design-thinking refinement of chatbot using real-time safety, accuracy and usefulness data
Structured patient exit interviews to gather feedback on chatbot

screen.reason: Prospective pilot deployment of an NLP-based mobile text chatbot (PENNY-GI) to support medication adherence and toxicity management among 40 cancer patients receiving capecitabine.
